description.value: The Fireweed Motel is a recently renovated motel situated in the heart of Smithers, BC, offering clean and comfortable rooms for travelers on the move. It positions itself as a convenient stopover along the Highway 16 corridor, with grocery stores and restaurants within walking distance. The property also offers a Ski & Stay package and is pet-friendly, reflecting the outdoor-oriented character of the Bulkley Valley region.
